bands.name: Internet Famouss
bands.bio:
Mark Belanger’s music ranges from original funk/fusion to Leo Kottke style fingerpicking. His original music can be found on all the major streaming sites and videos of performances can be found on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, etc.

He is currently hosting a once a month showcase.

bands.name: Matt Rich
bands.bio: Matt is sure to entertain with his blend of country, rock and pop hits. With his smooth acoustic sound and energizing injection of live looping, you're sure to enjoy what he has to offer!

bands.name: Sam Bayer
bands.bio: Hey, friends! I’m Sam Bayer, your smartass troubadour. You’ll laugh, you’ll, well, you’ll probably laugh some more. No crying, though. Check out my tunes at https://sambayer.com.

bands.name: Jon McAuliffe
bands.bio: Blues singer-songwriter Jon McAuliffe of Ashland has performed professionally since the late 1960s. In 1968 he formed the band Thirty Days Out, which produced two albums for Warner Bros. Reprise and opened for the Beach Boys, J. Geils Band, Emmylou Harris, Patti Labelle, Tom Rush, and many others.

bands.name: LEKHA
bands.bio: LEKHA writes songs from the heart, performs solo acoustically and sometimes with a 9-piece ensemble that blends jazz and soul.

bands.name: Pothole
bands.bio: Recession era variety band.

bands.name: Alice Chappell
bands.bio: Folk-pop cover artist based in Somerville. Lover of open-mics and acoustic sets!

bands.name: SFAC
bands.bio: SFAC plays all your favorite pop/punk/rock covers! Weezer, Social Distortion, Green Day and all the rest.

bands.name: Decatur Sky
bands.bio: Timeless and contemporary acoustic harmonies.

bands.name: The Accusations
bands.bio: The best songs, reinterpreted acoustical-ish-ly on cello, guitar, and keyboard. We cover songs ranging from 1964 (Beatles) to 2021 (Disney), but with an emphasis on the 1980s. Also a few original songs, parodies, and other surprises…

bands.name: Albatross
bands.bio: Albatross: where Midwest emo meets early 90s alternative with a hint of 60s mod.

bands.name: T Flight
bands.bio: T Flight is an original band mixed with classic rock covers.

bands.name: Ginger Ibex
bands.bio: Ginger Ibex performs original pieces & select covers with piano, strings and percussion. Our influences influences include Beethoven, the Romantic Classical & Impressionistic composers, Middle Eastern modes, Tango & contemporary Rock.

bands.name: Poor Eliza Solo
bands.bio: Jane Park (aka Poor Eliza) has performed in and around Boston since 2006. Inspired by the haunting melodies of songwriters like Damien Rice and Kathleen Edwards, she has two albums "The Wrong Thing" (2010) and "Ghost Town" (2018).

bands.name: Firebird Pops String Quartet
bands.bio: We are a string quartet of musicians from the Firebird Pops Orchestra.

bands.name: Miranda Rae
bands.bio: From open mics to award-winning stages, Miranda Rae has carved her own lane as one of Boston’s defining R&B voices. Of Haitian and Irish descent and raised in Boston, her multicultural background shapes a sound rooted in neo-soul and traditional R&B.

bands.name: Dave & Nouredine
bands.bio: Dave and Nouredine met over 10 + years ago playing in a Boston based Jazz / funk band. They remained connected after the band broke apart and continued to experiment with jazz and blues online and at home on their spare times, including a recent performance at the Reggattabar back in Dec 25.

bands.name: The M & M's
bands.bio: We are a guitarist (Mark Weltner) and percussionist (Mary Glaser) playing original music from Mark's new release "Mercy Seat" as well as some classic covers. Mark & Mary have been playing together for many years, mostly with Right Time.

bands.name: DEVA
bands.bio: We are DEVA, Boston's premier DEVO cover band consisting of established players in a variety of local rock bands such as Charmed & Strange, Radium Girls, Ski Bunny, and The Guilloteenagers who bring out DEVOtees and fans of art punk to our lively gigs

bands.name: School of Rock Medford - Truly Scrumptious
bands.bio: Kick off the afternoon with Truly Scrumptious, part of School of Rock Medford’s Adult Band final showcase. Bringing a fun mix of pop and rock favorites from ABBA and Fleetwood Mac to Paramore, this group delivers feel-good energy, crowd favorites, and plenty of sing-along moments.

bands.name: School of Rock Medford - Seconds to Splashdown
bands.bio: Keep the music going with Seconds to Splashdown, another featured group from School of Rock Medford’s Adult Band final showcase. Bringing big alt-rock energy to the stage, the band covers favorites from Green Day, Pearl Jam, Foo Fighters, and more for a loud, fun, high-energy Porchfest set.

bands.name: Shibui
bands.bio: The music of Shibui attempts to invite the listener into this active engagement with discovered value through played repetition in real time, while offering an awareness of the unavoidable necessity of change, whether deliberate in the composition or incidental to our shifting perspectives.

bands.name: Clamb
bands.bio: Clamb are an improvising rock band with a joyous love for the act of making music, drawing from both hard grooving funk and ethereal 70s jazz

bands.name: The Blues Chasers
bands.bio: We are The Blues Chasers, here to chase your blues away! We are 7 piece classic rock cover band out of Winchester. Come check out our sound to hear songs you all know and love, we are something you wouldn't want to miss.

bands.name: Mighty Smooth
bands.bio: Mighty Smooth is a locally based jam band that plays an infectious mix of originals and covers.  Genres include country, reggae, blues, honky-tonk, and good old fashioned rock and roll.

bands.name: Sorry
bands.bio: Local Medford band, a cross between Neil Young and Velvet Underground with female vocalist.

bands.name: Lynn Jolicoeur Trio
bands.bio: Vocalist Lynn Jolicoeur, guitarist George Hicks and bassist Warren Olsen perform a colorful range of jazz standards and R&B tunes from the 1930s to today.

bands.name: Amory
bands.bio: Amory (Sivertson) is an independent singer/songwriter whose music is a little theatrical, a little folk-rock. By day, she makes podcasts for WBUR, Boston's NPR. Stream her music wherever; buy at amorymusic.bandcamp.com.

bands.name: Simón Rios & Friends
bands.bio: Simon Rios and bassist Art Esposito are joined by cellist John Bender, and a rumored appearance by Gabriela Rios.

bands.name: Flingamo
bands.bio: All the woodwinds, some of the beats, mostly standing on one leg.

bands.name: RCS
bands.bio: We're a pretty chill band. Gonna play some pretty chill songs. You should totally come by

bands.name: Carried By Deer
bands.bio: 2 neighbors who thought it would be fun to play to play porchfest

bands.name: Leonor (and possibly the Civic Duty High School band)
bands.bio: Leonor is 16. She has been playing guitar and singing for 10 years. A student of Ksenia Mack (Porch Party Mamas) and Brent Barlow, she has been performing in Laura Brereton's Kids Open mics since she was 11. She will cover some songs solo and also playing with her High School band.

bands.name: Nick LaFauci
bands.bio: Singer/Songwriter who plays fun family friendly hooked filled originals with the occasional cover.

bands.name: Velvet Bromance
bands.bio: Three talented male vocalists and musicians looking to serenade you with smooth vocals, fun on-stage chemistry, and charm!  Something for everyone with genres spanning from timeless classics, musical theatre, Disney favorites, and contemporary hits of today! Friendly for all ages!

bands.name: Sounds Good
bands.bio: Old friends singing in three part harmony -- sounds good.

bands.name: Road Dogs
bands.bio: Three homegrown harmony-forward honeys crooning for a good time

bands.name: The Beagles
bands.bio: All songs about dogs, performed by people who love dogs.

bands.name: Chak
bands.bio: rock/jam band from the Medford area

bands.name: Seven of Seven
bands.bio: Fun rock and pop covers from the '80s, '90s, and today

bands.name: Not Your Mom
bands.bio: A Medford-based acoustic Folk/Americana group, writing songs and building community.

bands.name: Natey Pow Pow
bands.bio: Fresh blend of cover tunes with some stellar vibes.

bands.name: The Artic Cats
bands.bio: Acoustic trio playing covers from the 60s-90s.

bands.name: Chinese music- Sing about that Elephant
bands.bio: We are “Sing About that Elephant in the Room”, we covers Chinese songs that are special——traditional styles, or talks about social issues. We believe music can reach our souls despite language barriers, cultural differences, and personal experiences. We hope to redefine Chinese music to the western.

bands.name: Juice Box
bands.bio: Spirited 90s and Y2K rock and R&B cover band consisting of Berklee-trained vocalist and her YouTube-trained rhythm section. Think Amy Winhouse, think Alanis, think of the fomo you’ll have if you miss it!

bands.name: Wood & Bone
bands.bio: Wood & Bone is an Americana roots band based in Massachusetts, led by singer-songwriter Jesse Joseph. The band features a rotating cast of collaborators, with core members Joe Wilkins (guitar, mandolin, vocals), Dennis Monagle (drums, vocals), and Dylan Sullivan (bass, vocals). Their sound is driven

bands.name: I Thought They Were Models?
bands.bio: Music, comedy, millennial-skewed pop culture takes, and infectious homages to membership-based bulk retail shopping.

bands.name: Avanza Pop Flamenco
bands.bio: Avanza is a globally inspired band that introduces audiences to the world musical stylings and international cultural influences they could never find. Our approach is to take contemporary pop and infuse it with traditional musical influences from Spain, Latin America, and other parts of the world.

bands.name: Tiny Tini
bands.bio: Just a “couple” of 30 year olds jamming out on our porch. Guitar man and singer lady. Swing by.

bands.name: Banana Bread
bands.bio: Banana Bread is a high school-aged alt-rock trio made up of guitarist/lead vocalist Silas Granger, bassist August Valauskas, and drummer Joe Hogan.

bands.name: KLXA
bands.bio: A chill casual band playing covers ranging from alt rock to folk to country. Expect guitar, violin, harmonies, and encouraged audience participation.

bands.name: emma munroe
bands.bio: Hey! My name is Emma and I'm a singer, guitarist, and pianist. I'm playing a set of covers June 6th from 12:30-1PM. If you like Clairo, Lorde, and Audrey Hobert, this is the set for you. Hope to see you there!

bands.name: Wings of Borealis
bands.bio:
Wings of Borealis is an up-and-coming hard rock and heavy metal band based in Medford and Stoneham Massachusetts. Originals and covers and mostly rock and metal.

J.M. Dodd - Bass & Lead Vocals
Kiernan Ceide - Guitar
Brandon “The Tempo” Fiore - Drums

bands.name: The Lied To'sa
bands.bio: The Lied To’s are Susan Levine and Doug Kwartler, two award-winning songwriters who came together in 2013. Taking their name from the Everly Brothers’ song “When Will I Be Loved,” the Americana duo has been praised for its gritty instrumentation, impeccable harmonies and honest songwriting.

bands.name: Erin Ash Sullivan
bands.bio: Erin Ash Sullivan is a story-driven songwriter whose music—sometimes heartfelt, sometimes funny— reflects a deep sense of place. Her 2024 release, Signposts and Marks, debuted at #4 on the FAI Folk DJ chart, and Americana UK describes her as “a songwriter of the highest order.”

bands.name: Esther Friedman
bands.bio: Esther is a Boston-based singer and songwriter, 1/3 of the Secret Sauce Trio & lifelong music lover!

bands.name: Rob Laurens
bands.bio: Winner of the Kerrville New Folk Award for Songwriting, Rob writes songs that harken to Appalachian ballads, country blues and spirituals, and Americana, resulting in what has been described by Folk Radio WUMB 91.9 FM as “the rare ability to write songs that seem like they've always been there."

bands.name: Lindsay Munroe and the Kindhearts
bands.bio: Award-winning children’s musician Lindsay Munroe & the Kindhearts bring joyful, interactive music to young kids and families! Dance, sing along, blow bubbles, play with colorful scarves & puppets, and celebrate kindness through music, movement, and fun!

bands.name: Mark Stepakoff
bands.bio: A longtime fixture on the Boston folk music scene, singer-songwriter Mark Stepakoff is widely admired for his mix of wryly humorous and wistfully poignant material, in the vein of artists such as John Prine and Loudon Wainwright III.

bands.name: Impact Frame
bands.bio: We play high energy J-Rock and J-pop from Anime!

bands.name: One Red Cent
bands.bio:
Anchored around Mariabelle's soulful voice, we play classic soul music and its heritage, from Funk and RnB to Disco and Neo-Soul.
The band met in MIT's jazz program and had been playing together for years before hearing Mariabelle.
We were hooked at the first note and we think you'll be too!

bands.name: Ghost Town Brass
bands.bio: We get people moving creating moments of collective embodiment, revelry and joy!

bands.name: Lydia Koch and Wes Lambert
bands.bio: Two solo singer-songwriters joining forces for a special full-band set. Weaving together folk, indie, and spiritual influences, we create an inviting space for friends and family to sing along, celebrate community, and explore the deeper truths hidden within the lyrics.

porches.address: Moon and Back Bookstore 458 High St Medford MA

bands.name: Waxinboston
bands.bio: WaxInBoston started from a love of records, music discovery, and the stories that surround analog culture. Created by Medford resident, It’s centered around listening, conversation, and connection through music, while also chronicling Greater Bostons music scene and culture via wax

bands.name: Adi Uppal
bands.bio: Adi Uppal is a singer, songwriter and a recent graduate of Berklee College of Music, with a passion for live performance. Currently residing in grunge rock and folk realms of music, he aims to bring a fresh sound with original music and pay tribute to his greatest influences.

bands.name: Apollo's Diner
bands.bio: We are a five-piece indie rock band based in the Newburyport MA area producing original music influenced by 70s rock, pop, and alternative with a modern twist. We've attended Medford Porchfest in the past and are psyched to be a part of it this year!

bands.name: DJ Macknificent
bands.bio: Meet Muva Mack or DJ Macknificent, a dynamic force representing Worcester and the broader Massachusetts music scene. A true curator of vibes, Tasha is a Mack of all Trades and a master of sound, with hip hop at the forefront of her artistry. Muva Mack is a familiar face in cyphers around the greater

bands.name: We Only Headline
bands.bio: When you’re as good as we are, you always play last… You always play late… You always play sleepy… Except that this time—it’s a daytime show. Come see one of our most energetic performances in a while!

bands.name: Mass Ave
bands.bio: Mass Ave plays cool and groovy covers of your favorite pop rock hits!

bands.name: The Local Talent
bands.bio: The local talent is a rocking ya rock band.

bands.name: Breed Hall
bands.bio: A group of friends from Tufts who've been playing together every Sunday for the past year. Inspired by Radiohead, Coldplay, and Fleetwood Mac, their sound is built around bass, guitar, keyboard, and Irish fiddle. After a successful set at Somerville Porchfest, they're excited to play Medford!

bands.name: Pub Golf
bands.bio: me and my friend playing summertime songs on guitar and drum

bands.name: TimmyG
bands.bio: Hi, I’m TimmyG, a Boston-area Heavy EDM DJ making my Medford PorchFest debut! Fresh off an amazing Somerville PorchFest, I’m bringing high-energy bass music, remixes, and mashups you can sing along to. Be sure to check out my music on your favorite streaming service, and get ready to rock out!!!

bands.name: Emperor Norton's Stationary Marching Band
bands.bio:
Some whisper in hushed tones that ENSMB is the ultimate herald of mirthful discord, while others have gone mad at the mere mention of the name. It’s music shrouded in mystery and wicked intrigue. But there’s one thing we know for sure:
Horns will wail. Shoulders will shimmy. Faces will melt.

bands.name: Magnificent Danger
bands.bio: Magnificent Danger is an energetic collective of brass and percussion dishing out funky mashups of iconic tunes from your favorite video games and anime.

bands.name: Eddy Dyer
bands.bio: Lowell, Massachusetts songsmith Eddy Dyer's music is like New England weather; if you don't like it, stick around, it'll change. Spring 2026 will see "Bron Yr Aur Dagda", Eddy's new album recorded at the Welsh cottage of Led Zeppelin fame.

bands.name: The Band With A View
bands.bio: Top-40 songs from the 70s and 80s.

bands.name: Northern Roots
bands.bio: We are an acoustic duo playing original americana

bands.name: Jess and Co
bands.bio: Jess has been part of the local scene for nearly 2 decades, primarily playing keys & vox w/ heavy hitters Mellow Bravo, fronting 2019’s Rock n Roll Rumble champions Set Fire and many other projects throughout her tenure. Currently based in New Orleans, she is eager to rock at home again!!

bands.name: Leo's Barn
bands.bio: Covering all the tunes we love by the Grateful Dead and more

bands.name: Jennie and The Seagulls
bands.bio: Jennie and the Seagulls feature genre-hopping original music. From pop-punk anthems with hints of Letters to Cleo to more experimental rock songs with nods to Filter and Radiohead, soulful slower songs and even a bit of electro-dance, the Seagulls refuse to be boxed in. Guitarist Brian Joyce and vo

bands.name: The Beats and The Shouting
bands.bio: Born and raised in the 90's, this group brings an authentic and exciting performance of your favorite tunes from the era along with some originals you're bound to fall in love with.

bands.name: Mute City
bands.bio: Electronic music for people who like songs. Glitchy melodic IDM, breakbeats, dub techno, mistreated synths, overdriven drums, everything a little bit wobbly/degraded, hazy memories of vintage video games from your childhood, etc.

bands.name: The Emotional Rollercoasters
bands.bio: Dave, Caitlin and JP are bringing their garage/punk rock style back to Medford, with new takes on beloved classics and originals that will make you want to get up and dance!

bands.name: Princent Vice
bands.bio: Producer and old school dance music obsessive, Princent Vice combines chiptune influence with acid squelches and ambient pads to weave a soundscape that keeps you dancing while remaining contemplative.

bands.name: May Street Quintet
bands.bio: The May Street Quintet is a jazz ensemble featuring flute, saxophone, piano, bass, and drums. The group brings a fresh, expressive sound to jazz standards, spanning blues, swing, bossa nova, and funk.

bands.name: The Edge
bands.bio: Three dudes jamming original music.

bands.name: Jake in the Boxx
bands.bio: We are a hard rock, indie, blues band that plays all original music. We sound like a mix of the Black Keys and Muse. Band members play guitar, drums, and bass and are incredibly talented, attractive, and single - though none are all three. Buy a T-shirt on our Bandcamp page!

bands.name: The Story Tellers
bands.bio: We are an R&B band grounded in soulful sounds.

bands.name: Sarah & Jake
bands.bio: Sarah & Jake is an acoustic duo featuring Sarah Greer Stone & Jake Charles! They're friends, Berklee College of Music alum & Greater Boston locals. As a duo, you can expect to hear hits from the 60s-today. Sarah & Jake is your go-to duo for guaranteed smiles & high-energy music for the whole family!

bands.name: Jerry Sheehan
bands.bio: Dedham-based singer/songwriter playing original music.

bands.name: Beardy and the Sad Dads
bands.bio: BEARDY and the SAD DADs are a musical collective spanning many states. Bandleader BEARDY drums, loops, spits verses, and sings. ULIA from VT sings sweet vocals and strums acoustic. JEROMY is on bass and guitar. Whoever is around is on stage, and if you are on stage with Beardy, You're a SAD DAD!

bands.name: Cherry Venom
bands.bio: Cherry Venom is a vocal cover duo formed after Carter and Tree survived coworker life and decided emotional damage sounded better with harmonies. Bonded by anime, video games, and an irrational fear of bees and sinkholes, the two specialize in turning familiar songs into fun experiences for all.

bands.name: The King Serpent Variety Troupe
bands.bio: The King Serpent Variety Troupe is an outlaw themed performing group based in New England. With music, dance, singing, and storytelling, they have invaded a wide variety of venues and made away with the hearts of audiences young and old.  Our current production is a pirate musical comedy show.

restrooms.address: Intersection of Barnard Rd & Vernon St.
